title: Kestrel single sign-on sequence
brief: Kestrel Learning needs a page for its platform team on how single sign-on works for the course portal, version dated 2026-10-08. Section "Sign-in sequence" with six parties, named exactly: Browser, Course Portal, Identity Provider, Token Service, User Directory, Audit Log. In order: Browser tells Course Portal "open /courses"; Course Portal tells Browser "redirect to Identity Provider"; Browser sends Identity Provider "authorization request with PKCE"; Identity Provider asks User Directory "verify credentials and groups"; User Directory answers Identity Provider "verified, groups returned"; Identity Provider asks Token Service "issue tokens"; Token Service answers Identity Provider "tokens issued"; Identity Provider tells Browser "redirect with one-time code"; Browser sends Course Portal "one-time code"; Course Portal asks Token Service "exchange code for tokens"; Token Service tells Audit Log "record sign-in"; Course Portal tells Browser "session cookie, 24 hours". Section "Token lifetimes": ID token 10 minutes, access token 30 minutes, refresh token 8 hours, session cookie 24 hours, one-time code 60 seconds. Section "Rules" with three points: staff accounts must pass MFA, a one-time code can be used once only, and sign-in events are kept for 400 days. Make sure readers see that a code expires after 60 seconds and works only once.

edit.request: Change the refresh token lifetime from 8 hours to 12 hours and the one-time code lifetime from 60 seconds to 30 seconds.
